method.time_indexing: load[0] initializes previous FC; LP execution uses load[1:]
method.objective: maximize summed state of charge; used only to obtain an interpretable feasibility witness
method.primary_formulation: energy-scaled state E=624*SOC for numerical conditioning
method.crosscheck_formulation: direct SOC state with identical feasible set
method.classification_rule: both equivalent LP formulations must agree; infeasible requires both status_code=2
